LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Enlist_Letter_Label:
Welcome to Paradise Falls. You've proven yourself useful, and that's all that matters here. We deal in merchandise, pure and simple. Bring us quality stock, and you'll be rewarded handsomely.

Your cut comes every ten days. Don't expect handouts - you earn what you deliver. We've got holding facilities at our compounds where you can stash goods between runs. The boss has work for anyone willing to get their hands dirty.

Remember: business is business. Keep the merchandise in good condition, and we'll all profit.
LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Enlist_Button_Desc: Enter into a business arrangement with {FACTION_name}.

LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Menu_Missions_Desc: The boss has work that needs doing. Pays well if you can handle it.
LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Salary_Desc: Collect your cut from Paradise Falls operations every 10 days.
LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Provisions_Desc:
Basic supplies restocked to your caravan every 15 days:

- 12 Survival meal
- 4 Medicine
LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Storage_Desc: Store items at Paradise Falls facilities. Holdings are accessible at any compound and remain secure even if you end your association.
LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Guard_Duty_Desc: Pull shifts watching the pens and patrolling the compound for $15 an hour.
LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Turn_In_Desc: Deliver captured prisoners to Paradise Falls for payment.\n\n-Delivering hostile pawns does not incur slavery penalties-
LanguageData.FCP_Slaver_Resign_Menu_Text: You will sever ties with Paradise Falls. They don't take kindly to desertion. (-15 standing)
